candidate.historical_scope: Finite ground positive propositional STRIPS specialization, not full first-order STRIPS or 1959 Advice Taker
candidate.signature: (finite Pre, finite Add, finite Delete, finite Goal) -> POSSIBLE(required_before sorted atoms) | IMPOSSIBLE_BY_DELETE
preconditions: all elements are distinct lowercase ground atom IDs
no negative literals, quantifiers, hidden world state, effects or environmental assumptions

mathematical_law.theorem: for all S subset_of the finite universe: possible && RequiredBefore subset_of S iff action_applicable(S) && goal_after(S)
mathematical_law.impossible_convention: No S can achieve Goal by this action. This is NOT the same as POSSIBLE(required_before=[]).
mathematical_law.duplicate_and_overflow: all duplicated inputs, ambiguous Add∩Delete, or >16 atom universe reject (no guess)

source_hobby_connections: Advice Taker / symbolic plans: select lawful prerequisites of proposed actions, not try a blind search
Astronomy: prove prerequisites of acquiring an observation after mount alignment or exposure
ESP32-S3 / FPGA: model pure effects as an isolated mathematical data law, NOT GPIO/driver instructions
Chess or state-space search: backwards goal specification distinct from APPLY/UNDO engine
Panini formal rules: reason backwards about a transformation's required input without claiming grammar as Core opcode

falsifiers.must: cannot forget ready, otherwise empty state would falsely pass
BLOCKED ambiguous Add/Delete, do not invent effect priority
BLOCKED duplicate IDs rather than count them as multiset
MUST allow POSSIBLE([]) and keep it distinct from impossible
